basic_info.description: Classic Craftsman Charm in Prime Forest Hill Location. Set on an extra-wide lot just steps from Forest Hill Muni Station and West Portal Village, this detached Craftsman perfectly combines timeless character with versatile living spaces. The main level features 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, a formal living room with a fireplace, and an elegant dining room. A sun-filled kitchen with a skylight and greenhouse window opens to a cheerful breakfast room  ideal for casual dining, gatherings, and everyday living. Downstairs, the lower level offers exceptional flexibility, featuring 2 additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, a cozy den (ideal for a home office, playroom, or creative studio), and a comfortable family room. This level also features a private street entrance and direct access to a patio and a lush, gardener's dream yard  a serene retreat surrounded by mature trees and vibrant landscaping. Additional highlights include a laundry area, generous storage, a 1-car garage, and a long driveway providing ample off-street parking. Enjoy the best of city living in a peaceful setting  close to West Portal Village, Forest Hill Station, top-rated schools, Mollie Stone's Market, shops, dining, freeway access, and public transit.
